messages.subject: Can I calculate RMSEA in mirt?
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to do CFA in mirt and want to calculate RMSEA.

As you know, summary() write AIC, AICc,SABIC, BIC, logLik.

thanks

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Can I calculate RMSEA in mirt?
parts:
RMSEA will only be computed when the expected data table is not sparse, which generally requires datasets with only a few number of items. You'll have to use reduction based statistics such as the M2 from the M2() function. See the references therein for more detail.

Phil
